SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT ISNULL(ISNULL(MO_NO,PO_NO),' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ISNULL(ISNULL(MO_SEQ,PO_SEQ_NO),' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM IF_KEP_PO WHERE IF_REC_YN IN ('N','X') AND ORD_STATUS IN ('02','C')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'NETW' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, '01' AS REVISION, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(TYPE_CHECK,' ') AS TYPE_CHECK, CONVERT(CHAR(8),ORD_DATE,112) AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(PO_NO,' ') AS PO_NO, ISNULL(PO_SEQ_NO,' ') AS PO_SEQ_NO, ISNULL(CUST_BP_CD,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(CUST_BP_CD,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, ISNULL(CUST_BP_CD,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_DEPT, ISNULL(CUST_BP_NM,' ') AS CUST_BP_NM, ISNULL(ORD_DEPT_CD,' ') AS ORD_DEPT_CD, ISNULL(ORD_DEPT_NM,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, ISNULL(DLVY_DEPT_CD,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, ISNULL(DLVY_DEPT_NM,' ') AS DLVY_DEPT_NM, ISNULL(DLVY_DEPT_ITEM_ID,' ') AS DLVY_DEPT_ITEM_ID, ISNULL(ITEM_CD,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(CPO_ITEM_CD,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, ISNULL(REPLACE(ITEM_NM,'''',' '),' ') AS DESCRIPTION, ISNULL(REPLACE(SPEC,'''','′'),' ') AS SPECIFICATION, ISNULL(MODEL,' ') AS MODEL, ISNULL(MAKER,' ') AS MAKER, ISNULL(UNIT,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, ISNULL(ORD_QTY, 0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(ORD_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(ORD_QTY, 0)*ISNULL(ORD_PRICE,0) AS ITEM_AMT, ISNULL(ORD_USER_NM,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(ORD_USER_TEL,' ') AS ORD_USER_TEL, ISNULL(ORD_USER_ADDR,' ') AS ORD_USER_ADDR, ISNULL(TAX_YN,' ') AS TAX_YN, ISNULL(DLVY_MEMO,' ') AS DLVY_MEMO, ISNULL(RMK,' ') AS RMK, CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(CUST_BP_NM,' ')+'/'+ISNULL(DLVY_MEMO,' ')+ISNULL(RMK,' ')) AS REMARK, ISNULL(ZIP_CD,' ') AS ZIP_CD, CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(ZIP_CD,' ')+ISNULL(ORD_USER_ADDR,' ')) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, CONVERT(CHAR(8),DLVY_DATE,112) AS RD_DATE, CONVERT(CHAR(8),SUP_HOP_DATE,112) AS SUP_HOP_DATE, ISNULL(CUST_USER_ID,' ') AS CUST_USER_ID, ISNULL(CUST_PO_NO,' ') AS CUST_PO_NO, ISNULL(CUST_PO_SEQ,' ') AS CUST_PO_SEQ, CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(CUST_PO_NO,' ')+'^'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(CUST_PO_SEQ,' '))) AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(ORD_STATUS,' ') AS ORD_STATUS, ISNULL(IF_REC_YN,' ') AS IF_REC_YN , ISNULL(INQ_NO,' ') AS INQ_NO, ISNULL(ISNULL(MO_NO,PO_NO),' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ISNULL(ISNULL(MO_SEQ,PO_SEQ_NO),' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(ORD_DEPT_CD,' ')+'^'+ISNULL(ORD_DEPT_NM,' ')+'^'+ISNULL(MODEL,' ')+'^'+ISNULL(MAKER,' ')+'^'+ISNULL(INQ_NO,' ')+'^'+ISNULL(PO_NO,' ')+'^'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(PO_SEQ_NO,' '))) AS IV_COLUMN FROM IF_KEP_PO WHERE IF_REC_YN IN ('N','X') AND ORD_STATUS IN ('02','C') AND ISNULL(ISNULL(MO_NO,PO_NO),' ') = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND ISNULL(ISNULL(MO_SEQ,PO_SEQ_NO),' ') = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' ORDER BY PO_NO, PO_SEQ_NO
UPDATE IF_KEP_PO SET IF_REC_YN = 'Y', REC_DT = GETDATE() WHERE IF_REC_YN IN ('N','X') AND ORD_STATUS IN ('02','C') AND ISNULL(ISNULL(MO_NO,PO_NO),' ') = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND ISNULL(ISNULL(MO_SEQ,PO_SEQ_NO),' ') = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
